name: Nike Calm Slide 'Black'
story_html: The Nike Calm Slide 'Black' delivers an easy-to-wear slip-on in a stealthy finish. Built with flexible foam, the minimalist sandal is equipped with a comfortable wide-strap upper with debossed Nike Swoosh branding on the lateral side. A second larger Swoosh adorns the footbed, featuring a textured top layer that holds the foot securely in place. The seamless silhouette is underpinned by a full-length rubber outsole, good for durable traction on wet or dry surfaces.
